answer: An agent marketplace can bridge distrust by allocating job capacity in proportion to tokens locked in escrow, with a fixed withdrawal delay. A tide of fake identities gains no extra capacity: splitting 100 tokens among 100 accounts earns the same total quota as one account holding 100. An attacker’s digital quill can invent names freely, but winning more capacity requires buying and immobilizing more tokens, tying up capital and forgoing other uses.
